styleLock.direction: clean basic-apparel ecommerce, plain unadorned front panel, catalogue-grade packshot grammar
styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless pure white #FFFFFF for packshots and fit panels, matte dusty rose #E9C4BC for colour line-up and overhead close, warm light grey #F1F1F1 for texture macro, one real pegboard wall scene as the only environment shot
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft neutral studio light around 5500K, front or upper-left key with fill, gentle contact shadows that always ground the fabric, no harsh speculars, identical light on every unit of a group
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte seamless paper for studio frames; fabric itself is the only surface texture, folds crisp and natural, no wrinkle mess
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif reserved for post-production only; in-image words stay as blank chips and empty leader lines, no rendered copy
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight #2D2D2D leader lines, small dots and empty rounded label chips only, no arrows that crown one option, no badge artwork
styleLock.presentationRules: garment always shown flat or hung square to camera with the front panel empty; identical scale and identical collar height across every unit in a group; colourways reproduced exactly from the reference image, never re-tinted
noDrift: no inconsistent lighting between units of the same group
no added pocket, print, embroidery or logo on the front panel
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean basic-apparel ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF, matte dusty rose #E9C4BC, warm light grey #F1F1F1 and charcoal line and text colour #2D2D2D; bright soft neutral 5500K studio lighting with an upper-left key, fill and believable contact shadows, identical light on every unit inside one frame; modern geometric sans-serif kept out of the render, so all in-image words stay as blank label chips and empty leader lines; consistent thin single-weight line icon style; clean high-end apparel packshot photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable square-to-camera garment angle, empty front panel and locked scale across the set; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, garment laid flat square to camera, full silhouette visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key neutral 5500K studio light, front key with fill card on the shadow side, soft contact shadow only
shots.promptTemplate: Packshot of {product} laid flat and square to the camera, straight-on eye-level view with the full silhouette visible and the front panel completely empty. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The job is the search-result click, so the silhouette must read in under a second. Bright even high-key neutral 5500K studio light with a front key and a fill card on the shadow side, soft contact shadow only so the fabric stays grounded. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. No props. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame, centred, no extra whitespace and no reserved copy area. Square 1:1 framing, 2K, commercial apparel catalogue quality. Negative: no added chest patch pocket, no printed graphic or lettering, no fake brand logo, no hanger, no model or mannequin, no hands, no watermark, no in-image text, no badge or ribbon sticker, no gradient background, no cut-off sleeves or hem, no stiff cardboard-looking fabric.

Soft neutral 5500K key from the upper left with even fill, the same exposure on every unit, gentle contact shadows under each fold. Matte dusty rose background field #E9C4BC, seamless. No props. The line-up occupies 60-70% of the frame with the outer two units lightly cropped by the frame edge, even breathing margin top and bottom, no reserved copy area. Square 1:1, 2K. Negative: no mixed lighting between units, no duplicated collar or sleeve parts, no colour drift away from the reference colourways, no gradient background, no printed graphics or text on any unit, no fake logo, no watermark, no in-image text, no hangers, no model.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：01 多件素色圆领短袖平列成阵（六色）；02 单件平铺纯白底正视图；03 单件平铺于藕粉底色，右上角另有品牌字标与英文品名；04 与 06 为同一构图（近重复）——右侧挂装单件＋左侧整叠折叠件，叠加件数角标、三档版型（偏长／标准／偏小）对照文字与领口、袖口引线标注；05 四件挂于木质洞洞板墙面的生活化场景。品类判定依据：图内为可外穿的素色圆领短袖上衣，前片干净无口袋，标注含加长版型档，属贴身汗衫以外的外穿款，故判男装/上衣；源类目路径挂在女装上衣，与图不符，按图改判。leaf 与 slug 强调无口袋素色基础多件装，以区别库内已有的左胸贴袋工装款（源图未见任何口袋）。已剥离：源品牌字标与系列名、件数角标、平台徽标与星级评价、原价与售价字样、英文品名与三档版型原句（一律改为空白标签位与空引线）、以及一切面料克重与尺寸数值；产品全程以 {product} 占位，色名不做 hex 硬编码，由参考图注入。
